scope: Twelve engine paths inherited from Slice 115; this subset does not freeze the complete Phase 1 protocol or installed SDK cells

candidate_product_snapshot.rule: Record the full exact source SHA and binary hash for each block. A change to Rust crate tree or Cargo.lock after this freeze requires new candidate builds and affected-cell reruns; if workload semantics change, revise and refreeze this subset before timing.

workload.tokenizer_sha256_binding: The exact tokenizer.json checksum is pinned in scripts/slice135_e12_adapter.py at adapter_sha256 above and is checked against disk before timing; the retained pilot protocol.json files record the same checksum.
workload.measurement_boundary: Engine call entry through materialized result or completed named lifecycle transition; seed/setup, warmup and independent verification excluded from each timer
workload.state_and_output_rule: Every valid attempt must match e12-expected-checks.json exactly; retain ordered query IDs and branches plus named lifecycle, graph, evidence and erasure states
workload.negative_control_rule: The independent audit must reject altered source, artifact, sample count, state and ordered output before any paired conclusion

analysis.pair_summary_rule: Report every pair's delta, median and full observed range for each cell and supported percentile; report raw per-block values and noisy/inconclusive cells without a significance or regression-threshold claim from five pairs
analysis.resource_rule: Record measured-child GNU Time user/system CPU, peak RSS, filesystem I/O, major faults, swap and whole-block wall time; do not attribute whole-block resources to individual calls
analysis.cold_rule: The warm-up and first session access are not evidence of a cold OS/model-cache percentile. Report named open_fresh/open_populated cells separately.

validity.host_only_swap_counter_drift: Retain and flag; report sensitivity with warning-free pairs rather than silently discarding or treating it as measured-child swap
validity.attempt_rule: Preserve every attempt, invalid reason and slow valid sample. Do not replace a valid slow sample.

interpretation: This is a paired engine diagnostic under one fixed 32-row CPU workload. It is not installed-SDK system latency, a competitor verdict, gold correctness or a release gate.
